Attacks on Agents

Abstract
We study multi-turn jailbreak attacks on tool-using agents. Attack success rises from 12% single-turn to 47% multi-turn.

1. Introduction
Agents act over many steps, so single-turn tests miss failures.

2. Results
On the Darcy benchmark of agent tasks, our attack succeeds in 47% of episodes.

3. Conclusion
Multi-turn attacks are stronger than single-turn ones.
